description: The local agent's setup wizard / console (http://127.0.0.1:<port>) may only sync the 'start at login' choice with the app and ask for a fresh credential for the console it is (console_access_token: the local agent's current console token, or for a paired host's console behind the tunnel a short-lived access token; the device key stays in native code), so the console never shows a login prompt inside the app. Nothing else from those pages reaches native code.
